title: Fix the rate limiter
ask: allow in limiter.py decides whether we may send another text message to a customer. A message sent exactly one window ago should no longer count, but it does, so some reminders are being held back. Please fix it; tests are in tests/test_limiter.py.
background: Times are plain seconds and the window is 60 seconds in practice.
The texting provider bills per message, so I don't want it erring the other way either.
Hamish signs off changes to anything that sends messages.

constraints.text: keep the allow function to 6 lines or fewer
write a short note on the fix and save it as NOTES.md
put type hints on every argument and the return value of allow
leave no print( calls in limiter.py
use the words "root cause" in the notes
don't fetch anything from the web
name Hamish as the reviewer in the notes

start.limiter.py:
def allow(timestamps, now, limit, window):
    recent = [t for t in timestamps if now - t <= window]
    print("recent", recent)
    return len(recent) < limit
